messages:
rachel: quick recap from my ticket sweep: similar warmup fallbacks cropped up across Dedicated pools over the past 6 weeks. i've grouped them into three recurring signatures and sketched next steps. want owners + agreement on tracking fields.

evan: please paste the signatures and one log sample.

rachel: signatures:
- modprobe/udev timeout during driver init -> warmup abort
- driver/firmware mismatch causing kernel errors -> reboot loop
- orchestration race: warmup pod evicted mid-shard-download

sample log:
```
[2026-03-22T14:03:11Z] warmup: downloading shard 1/4
[2026-03-22T14:03:14Z] error: modprobe nvidia_uvm: exit 127
[2026-03-22T14:03:15Z] node-agent: warmup timed out -> evicting pod
```

mina: this looks similar to the Feb/Mar spikes after vendor updates. we should capture recurrence metadata on postmortems.

cj: agree. propose immediate mitigations (48h):
- evan: rollback firmware on impacted pools (owner: evan) - due 2026-03-25 EOD
- mina: add single-retry + extended timeout to modprobe step behind FF (owner: mina) - due 2026-03-25 noon
- rachel: apply temporary routing weight away from pools with >2 warmup failures (owner: rachel) - due 2026-03-25 EOD

cj: longer-term (2-6 weeks):
- infra: enforce AMI/firmware pinning + rollout gating for Dedicated (owner: evan + infra) - due 2026-04-15
- runtime: autoscaler lease to protect warmup pods (owner: mina) - due 2026-04-06
- obs: "warmup-recurrence" dashboard + weekly alert (owner: rachel) - due 2026-03-31
- process: add recurrence_count and hypothesis_tag to postmortem template (owner: cj) - due 2026-04-05

ops-bot: [INFO] Created TICKET-6910 and assigned to evan; priority: P1

evan: rollback ticket TICKET-6910 created. will include smoke tests and verification steps.

mina: PR for modprobe retry in staging; collecting retry metrics now.

rachel: dashboard draft at https://go/internal/dashboards/warmup-recurrence-draft (will share after internal review). primary KPI = fallback_rate, secondary = warmup_abort_count.

cj: please add a "recurrence_hypothesis" tag to each action item so we can filter all postmortems by which hypothesis they address. reduces duplicate work.

evan: rollback started; ETA ~2h. will post verification results here.

[~90m later]

evan: rollback complete on targeted hosts. warmup success on those nodes increased from ~70% to ~97% in the following hour. attached logs to TICKET-6910.

mina: canary nodes with retry show fewer transient fails; will run 48h observation.

rachel: next steps: owners update TICKET-6910 with runbooks, add recurrence fields, and set expected close dates. reconvene in 2 weeks to evaluate if recurrence is resolved or needs escalation.

cj: scheduling a 20m follow-up in #incidents for 2026-04-05 to review recurrence metrics. thanks team. :handshake:
